moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio arc-travel, written here): Square follows a quadratic Bézier, rotation fixed. Recipe: x 0 → 90 → 180 px with y 0 → −70 → 0 (apex at 400 ms), 800 ms sine.inOut. Site demo: P0 (0,0), control (104,−124), P2 (208,0) (apex −62 px), traversed at constant speed in 2200 ms linear. Control lines and labels are guides only. Params: duration (0.8 s) · x (180 px) · height: độ cao đỉnh cung (70 px) · ease (sine.inOut). The square keeps its orientation along the arc.
